#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""PDF -> Markdown converter that emits <!-- PAGE n --> markers.

Usage:
    python3 pdf2md_conv.py <input.pdf> <output.md> [from_page] [to_page]

Requirements: poppler's `pdftohtml` must be on PATH. Pure Python stdlib.
Every PDF page produces exactly one `<!-- PAGE n -->` marker, in order,
so page markers map 1:1 to the PDF's real pages.
"""
import sys
import os
import re
import subprocess
import html as _html
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

HEAD_COLORS = {"#5e83a3", "#000000", "#656565", "#000000"}
LINK_COLOR = "#0000ff"


def xml_text(node):
    return "".join(node.itertext())


def get_xml(pdf_path):
    p = subprocess.run(
        ["pdftohtml", "-xml", "-stdout", "-q", pdf_path],
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
    )
    data = p.stdout
    data = data.replace(b"\xfe\xff", b"")
    text = data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    text = re.sub(r"<filename>.*?</filename>", "", text, flags=re.S)
    return text


def parse_outline(root):
    """Return list of (page, level, title)."""
    out = []

    def walk(node, depth):
        for el in node:
            if el.tag == "outline":
                walk(el, depth + 1)
            elif el.tag == "item":
                page = int(el.get("page", "0") or 0)
                title = xml_text(el).strip()
                if page and title:
                    out.append((page, depth + 1, title))
                for sub in el:
                    if sub.tag == "outline":
                        walk(sub, depth + 1)

    walk(root, 0)
    # de-dup
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for pg, lvl, title in out:
        key = (pg, lvl, title)
        if key not in seen:
            seen.add(key)
            result.append(key)
    return result


class Line:
    __slots__ = ("top", "left", "height", "size", "family", "color", "text")

    def __init__(self, top, left, height, size, family, color, text):
        self.top = top
        self.left = left
        self.height = height
        self.size = size
        self.family = family
        self.color = color
        self.text = text


def parse_page(page_el, fonts):
    """Return list of Line objects (already grouped by row, sorted top->bottom, l->r)."""
    rows = {}

    def text_content(t):
        return xml_text(t)

    for t in page_el.findall(".//text"):
        top = int(round(float(t.get("top", "0"))))
        left = float(t.get("left", "0"))
        height = int(round(float(t.get("height", "0"))))
        fid = t.get("font", "0")
        size = fonts.get(fid, (0, "Times"))[0]
        family = fonts.get(fid, (0, "Times"))[1]
        color = ""
        txt = xml_text(t)
        # color lookup
        if fid in font_colors:
            color = font_colors[fid]
        if txt.strip() == "":
            continue
        key = int(top // 4) * 4  # bucket row by ~4 unit tolerance
        rows.setdefault((key, top), []).append([top, left, height, size, family, color, txt])

    lines = []
    for (key, top) in sorted(rows.keys(), key=lambda k: k[1]):
        runs = rows[(key, top)]
        runs.sort(key=lambda r: r[1])  # sort by left
        # merge runs into segments, respecting visual gaps
        segs = []
        cur = None
        for top_r, left, height, size, family, color, txt in runs:
            if cur is None:
                cur = [left, left, height, size, family, color, txt]
            else:
                gap = left - cur[1]
                joined = cur[6] + (" " if gap > 2 else "") + txt
                # keep it simple: same-row runs belong to one visual line; we
                # will later split columns for tables based on big gaps.
                cur[1] = left
                cur[6] = joined
        segs.append(cur)
        for s in segs:
            lines.append(Line(s[0], s[2], s[3], s[4], s[5], s[6], s[7]))
    return lines


def parse_all(xml_text_str):
    root = ET.fromstring(xml_text_str)
    outline = parse_outline(root)
    pages = []
    fonts = {}
    font_colors = {}
    global font_colors
    for p in root.findall(".//page"):
        pnum = int(p.get("number", "0"))
        # fontspec is child of page
        for fs in p.findall("./fontspec"):
            fid = fs.get("id")
            size = int(float(fs.get("size", "0")))
            family = fs.get("family", "Times")
            color = fs.get("color", "#000000")
            fonts[fid] = (size, family)
            font_colors[fid] = color
        pages.append((pnum, p))
    return outline, pages, fonts, font_colors


# global font_colors initialized in parse_all via closure
font_colors = {}


def normalize_title(s):
    s = re.sub(r"\bChapter\s+\d+\b", "", s, flags=re.I)
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip().lower()


def heading_level_for_line(line, outline_titles):
    """Return heading level (1-6) or 0 if not a heading."""
    if line.size < 15:
        return 0
    if line.family != "Times":
        return 0
    if line.color == LINK_COLOR:
        return 0
    if line.size >= 23:
        return 1
    if line.size >= 16:
        return 2
    return 0


def is_code(line):
    fam = (line.family or "").lower()
    return "courier" in fam or "mono" in fam or "console" in fam


def render(outline, pages, fonts):
    from_page = int(os.environ.get("FROM_PAGE", "1"))
    to_page = int(os.environ.get("TO_PAGE", "0")) or 1 << 30

    headings_by_page = {}
    for pg, lvl, title in outline:
        headings_by_page.setdefault(pg, []).append((lvl, title))

    out = []
    body_started = False

    for pnum, p in pages:
        if pnum < from_page:
            continue
        if pnum > to_page:
            break
        lines = parse_page(p, fonts)
        # emit page marker
        out.append("")
        out.append("<!-- PAGE %d -->" % pnum)
        out.append("")

        # outline headings for this page
        page_titles = headings_by_page.get(pnum, [])
        emitted_titles = set()
        for lvl, title in page_titles:
            nt = normalize_title(title)
            out.append("#" * min(lvl, 6) + " " + title)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""PDF -> Markdown converter that emits one <!-- PAGE n --> marker per PDF page.

Usage:
    python3 pdf2md_conv.py <input.pdf> <output.md> [from_page] [to_page]

Requirements: poppler's `pdftohtml` must be on PATH. Pure Python stdlib.
Page markers map 1:1 to the PDF's real pages (page 1 -> `<!-- PAGE 1 -->`, etc.).
"""
import sys
import os
import re
import subprocess
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

LINK_COLOR = "#0000ff"


def xml_text(node):
    return "".join(node.itertext())


def get_xml(pdf_path):
    p = subprocess.run(
        ["pdftohtml", "-xml", "-stdout", "-q", pdf_path],
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
    )
    data = p.stdout
    data = data.replace(b"\xfe\xff", b"")
    text = data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    text = re.sub(r"<filename>.*?</filename>", "", text, flags=re.S)
    return text


def parse_outline(root):
    """Return list of (page, level, title)."""
    out = []

    def walk(node, depth):
        for el in node:
            if el.tag == "outline":
                walk(el, depth + 1)
            elif el.tag == "item":
                page = int(el.get("page", "0") or 0)
                title = xml_text(el).strip()
                if page and title:
                    out.append((page, depth + 1, title))
                for sub in el:
                    if sub.tag == "outline":
                        walk(sub, depth + 1)

    walk(root, 0)
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for item in out:
        if item not in seen:
            seen.add(item)
            result.append(item)
    return result


class Run:
    __slots__ = ("left", "text", "size", "family", "color")

    def __init__(self, left, text, size, family, color):
        self.left = left
        self.text = text
        self.size = size
        self.family = family
        self.color = color


class Line:
    __slots__ = ("top", "left", "height", "size", "family", "color", "text", "runs")

    def __init__(self, top, left, height, size, family, color, text, runs):
        self.top = top
        self.left = left
        self.height = height
        self.size = size
        self.family = family
        self.color = color
        self.text = text
        self.runs = runs


def parse_page(page_el, fonts):
    """Group text runs into visual lines sorted top->bottom."""
    rows = {}
    for t in page_el.findall("./text"):
        top = int(round(float(t.get("top", "0"))))
        left = float(t.get("left", "0"))
        height = int(round(float(t.get("height", "0"))))
        fid = t.get("font", "0")
        size, family, color = fonts.get(fid, (0, "Times", "#000000"))
        txt = xml_text(t)
        if not txt.strip():
            continue
        bucket = int(top // 3)  # ~3 unit vertical tolerance to merge sub/superscripts
        rows.setdefault((bucket, top), []).append(
            Run(left, txt, size, family, color))

    lines = []
    for (bucket, top) in sorted(rows.keys(), key=lambda k: k[1]):
        runs = rows[(bucket, top)]
        runs.sort(key=lambda r: r.left)
        # merge overlapping / adjacent runs into a single text, keep raw runs for tables
        merged = []
        prev = None
        for r in runs:
            if prev is not None and (r.left - prev[1]) < 2.0:
                prev[1] = max(prev[1], r.left + len(r.text) * 5.0)
                prev[0] += r.text
                prev_run = prev[2]
            else:
                prev = [r.text, r.left + len(r.text) * 5.0, r]
                merged.append(prev)
        text = " ".join(m[0] for m in merged).strip()
        if not text:
            continue
        # dominant style
        size = max(r.size for r in runs)
        line = Line(top, runs[0].left, height, size, runs[0].family, runs[0].color, text, runs)
        # refine family/color from the largest-font run
        for r in runs:
            if r.size == size:
                line.family = r.family
                line.color = r.color
                break
        lines.append(line)
    return lines


def normalize(s):
    s = re.sub(r"\bChapter\s+\d+\b", "", s, flags=re.I)
    s = re.sub(r"^[0-9]+$", "", s)
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip().lower()


def heading_level(line):
    if line.size < 13 or line.family != "Times" or line.color == LINK_COLOR:
        return 0
    if line.size >= 23:
        return 1
    if line.size >= 16:
        return 2
    if line.size >= 13:
        return 3
    return 0


def is_code(line):
    fam = (line.family or "").lower()
    return ("courier" in fam) or ("mono" in fam) or ("console" in fam)


def main():
    args = sys.argv[1:]
    if len(args) < 2:
        print("usage: pdf2md_conv.py <pdf> <out.md> [from] [to]", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(2)
    pdf = args[0]
    outmd = args[1]
    from_page = int(args[2]) if len(args) >= 3 else 1
    to_page = int(args[3]) if len(args) >= 4 else (1 << 30)

    xml = get_xml(pdf)
    root = ET.fromstring(xml)
    outline = parse_outline(root)

    # collect pages + fonts
    pages = []
    fonts = {}
    for p in root.findall(".//page"):
        pnum = int(p.get("number", "0"))
        for fs in p.findall("./fontspec"):
            fid = fs.get("id")
            fonts[fid] = (
                int(float(fs.get("size", "0"))),
                fs.get("family", "Times"),
                fs.get("color", "#000000"),
            )
        pages.append((pnum, p))

    # parse all pages (needed for chrome detection)
    all_lines = {}
    page_h = {}
    for pnum, p in pages:
        ph = int(float(p.get("height", "0") or "0"))
        page_h[pnum] = ph
        all_lines[pnum] = parse_page(p, fonts)

    # --- running header/footer (chrome) detection ---
    top_counts = {}
    bot_counts = {}
    total = max(1, len(pages))
    for pnum, p in pages:
        ph = page_h.get(pnum, 1000) or 1000
        ls = all_lines[pnum]
        for ln in ls:
            txt = re.sub(r"[0-9]", "", ln.text).strip()
            if not txt:
                continue
            ntxt = normalize(txt)
            if ln.top <= 0.08 * ph:
                top_counts[ntxt] = top_counts.get(ntxt, 0) + 1
            if ln.top >= 0.78 * ph:
                bot_counts[ntxt] = bot_counts.get(ntxt, 0) + 1
    threshold = max(20, int(total * 0.6))
    chrome_top = set(k for k, v in top_counts.items() if v >= threshold)
    chrome_bot = set(k for k, v in bot_counts.items() if v >= threshold)

    headings_by_page = {}
    for pg, lvl, title in outline:
        headings_by_page.setdefault(pg, []).append((lvl, title))

    out = []
    for pnum, p in pages:
        if pnum < from_page:
            continue
        if pnum > to_page:
            break
        ph = page_h.get(pnum, 1000) or 1000
        lines = all_lines[pnum]
        page_titles = headings_by_page.get(pnum, [])

        out.append("")
        out.append("<!-- PAGE %d -->" % pnum)
        out.append("")

        emitted = set()
        for lvl, title in page_titles:
            out.append("#" * min(lvl, 6) + " " + title)
            emitted.add(normalize(title))

        i = 0
        n = len(lines)
        para = []

        def flush():
            if para:
                out.append(" ".join(para))
                para.clear()
            out.append("")

        while i < n:
            ln = lines[i]
            t = ln.text.strip()
            ph_ = page_h.get(pnum, 1000) or 1000
            # skip chrome
            ntxt = normalize(re.sub(r"[0-9]", "", t))
            if ntxt and ((ln.top <= 0.08 * ph_ and ntxt in chrome_top)
                         or (ln.top >= 0.78 * ph_ and ntxt in chrome_bot)):
                i += 1
                continue
            if not t:
                i += 1
                continue
            if is_code(ln):
                flush()
                buf = []
                while i < n and is_code(lines[i]):
                    buf.append(lines[i].text.rstrip())
                    i += 1
                out.append("```svrf")
                out.extend(buf)
                out.append("```")
                out.append("")
                continue
            lvl = heading_level(ln)
            if lvl:
                nt = normalize(t)
                if nt and any(nt and (nt in e or e in nt) for e in emitted):
                    i += 1
                    continue
                flush()
                out.append("#" * lvl + " " + re.sub(r"^Chapter\s+\d+\s*", "", t).strip())
                out.append("")
                i += 1
                continue
            para.append(t)
            i += 1
        flush()

    md = "\n".join(out).rstrip() + "\n"
    with open(outmd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(md)
    markers = md.count("<!-- PAGE ")
    print("pages=%d markers=%d outline=%d bytes=%d chrome_top=%d chrome_bot=%d" % (
        len(pages), markers, len(outline), len(md), len(chrome_top), len(chrome_bot)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""PDF -> Markdown converter emitting one <!-- PAGE n --> marker per PDF page.

Usage:
    python3 pdf2md_conv.py <input.pdf> <output.md> [from_page] [to_page]

Requirements:
    * poppler's `pdftohtml` available on PATH.
    * Python 3 standard library only.

Page markers map 1:1 to the PDF's real pages: page 1 -> `<!-- PAGE 1 -->`,
page 2 -> `<!-- PAGE 2 -->`, and so on, in ascending order.
"""
import sys
import re
import subprocess
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

LINK_COLOR = "#0000ff"


def xml_text(node):
    return "".join(node.itertext())


def get_xml(pdf_path):
    p = subprocess.run(
        ["pdftohtml", "-xml", "-stdout", "-q", pdf_path],
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
    )
    data = p.stdout
    data = data.replace(b"\xfe\xff", b"")
    text = data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    text = re.sub(r"<filename>.*?</filename>", "", text, flags=re.S)
    return text


def parse_outline(root):
    """Return list of (page, level, title) tuples from PDF bookmarks."""
    out = []

    def walk(node, depth):
        for el in node:
            if el.tag == "outline":
                walk(el, depth + 1)
            elif el.tag == "item":
                page = int(el.get("page", "0") or 0)
                title = xml_text(el).strip()
                if page and title:
                    out.append((page, depth + 1, title))
                for sub in el:
                    if sub.tag == "outline":
                        walk(sub, depth + 1)

    walk(root, 0)
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for item in out:
        if item not in seen:
            seen.add(item)
            result.append(item)
    return result


class Run:
    __slots__ = ("left", "right", "size", "family", "color", "bold", "text")

    def __init__(self, left, right, size, family, color, bold, text):
        self.left = left
        self.right = right
        self.size = size
        self.family = family
        self.color = color
        self.bold = bold
        self.text = text


class Line:
    __slots__ = ("top", "left", "height", "size", "family", "color", "bold", "text", "runs")

    def __init__(self, top, left, height, size, family, color, bold, text, runs):
        self.top = top
        self.left = left
        self.height = height
        self.size = size
        self.family = family
        self.color = color
        self.bold = bold
        self.text = text
        self.runs = runs


def parse_page(page_el, fonts):
    rows = {}
    for t in page_el.findall("./text"):
        top = int(round(float(t.get("top", "0"))))
        left = float(t.get("left", "0"))
        width = float(t.get("width", "0") or "0")
        right = left + width
        height = int(round(float(t.get("height", "0"))))
        fid = t.get("font", "0")
        size, family, color = fonts.get(fid, (0, "Times", "#000000"))
        bold = t.find("b") is not None or t.find(".//b") is not None
        txt = xml_text(t)
        if not txt.strip():
            continue
        bucket = int(top // 3)
        rows.setdefault((bucket, top), []).append(
            Run(left, right, size, family, color, bold, txt))

    lines = []
    for (bucket, top) in sorted(rows.keys(), key=lambda k: k[1]):
        runs = rows[(bucket, top)]
        runs.sort(key=lambda r: r.left)
        # merge runs that belong to the same visual line
        merged = []
        prev = None
        for r in runs:
            if prev is not None and prev.right + 2.0 >= r.left:
                # no gap -> concatenate without space (subscripts/symbols)
                prev.text += r.text
                prev.right = max(prev.right, r.right)
                if prev.size < r.size:
                    prev.size = r.size
                    prev.family = r.family
                    prev.color = r.color
            else:
                prev = Run(r.left, r.right, r.size, r.family, r.color, r.bold, r.text)
                merged.append(prev)
        text = " ".join(m.text for m in merged).strip()
        if not text:
            continue
        size = max(r.size for r in merged)
        all_bold = all(r.bold for r in merged)
        family = merged[0].family
        color = merged[0].color
        for m in merged:
            if m.size == size:
                family = m.family
                color = m.color
                break
        lines.append(Line(top, merged[0].left, height, size, family, color, all_bold, text, merged))
    return lines


def norm_title(s):
    s = re.sub(r"\bChapter\s+\d+\b", "", s, flags=re.I)
    s = re.sub(r"^\bAppendix\s+[A-Z]\b", "", s, flags=re.I)
    s = s.strip(" .:\t")
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip().lower()


def is_code_line(line):
    fam = (line.family or "").lower()
    return ("courier" in fam) or ("mono" in fam) or ("console" in fam)


def main():
    args = sys.argv[1:]
    if len(args) < 2:
        print("usage: pdf2md_conv.py <pdf> <out.md> [from] [to]", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(2)
    pdf = args[0]
    outmd = args[1]
    from_page = int(args[2]) if len(args) >= 3 else 1
    to_page = int(args[3]) if len(args) >= 4 else (1 << 30)

    xml = get_xml(pdf)
    root = ET.fromstring(xml)
    outline = parse_outline(root)

    pages = []
    for p in root.findall("./page"):
        pages.append((int(p.get("number", "0")), p))

    # global font table (ids are document-wide and unique in a single run)
    fonts = {}
    for fs in root.findall(".//fontspec"):
        fonts[fs.get("id")] = (
            int(float(fs.get("size", "0"))),
            fs.get("family", "Times"),
            fs.get("color", "#000000"),
        )

    # parse every page once so that body size / chrome can be computed globally
    parsed = {}
    page_h = {}
    for pnum, p in pages:
        ph = int(float(p.get("height", "0") or "0"))
        page_h[pnum] = ph if ph > 0 else 1188
        parsed[pnum] = parse_page(p, fonts)

    # ---- global body font size (mode of normal body runs) ----
    size_counts = {}
    for pnum, _ in pages:
        for ln in parsed[pnum]:
            for r in ln.runs:
                if r.family == "Times" and r.color != LINK_COLOR and 8 <= r.size <= 40:
                    size_counts[r.size] = size_counts.get(r.size, 0) + 1
    body_size = 16
    if size_counts:
        body_size = max(size_counts, key=size_counts.get)

    # ---- running header / footer detection ----
    top_counts = {}
    bot_counts = {}
    total = max(1, len(pages))
    for pnum, _ in pages:
        ph = page_h[pnum]
        for ln in parsed[pnum]:
            t = re.sub(r"[0-9]", "", ln.text).strip()
            if not t:
                continue
            nt = norm_title(t)
            if ln.top <= 0.09 * ph:
                top_counts[nt] = top_counts.get(nt, 0) + 1
            if ln.top >= 0.85 * ph:
                bot_counts[nt] = bot_counts.get(nt, 0) + 1
    threshold = max(20, int(total * 0.6))
    chrome_top = set(k for k, v in top_counts.items() if v >= threshold)
    chrome_bot = set(k for k, v in bot_counts.items() if v >= threshold)

    headings_by_page = {}
    for pg, lvl, title in outline:
        headings_by_page.setdefault(pg, []).append((lvl, title))

    out = []
    for pnum, p in pages:
        if pnum < from_page:
            continue
        if pnum > to_page:
            break
        ph = page_h[pnum]
        lines = parsed[pnum]
        page_titles = headings_by_page.get(pnum, [])

        out.append("")
        out.append("<!-- PAGE %d -->" % pnum)
        out.append("")

        emitted = set()
        for lvl, title in page_titles:
            out.append("#" * min(lvl, 6) + " " + title)
            emitted.add(norm_title(title))

        i = 0
        n = len(lines)
        prev_bottom = -1
        first = True

        def flush_blank():
            if out and out[-1] != "":
                out.append("")

        while i < n:
            ln = lines[i]
            t = ln.text.strip()

            # skip running chrome
            nt_raw = re.sub(r"[0-9]", "", t).strip()
            nt = norm_title(nt_raw) if nt_raw else ""
            if ln.top >= 0.85 * ph:
                if not nt_raw or (nt in chrome_bot):
                    i += 1
                    continue
            if ln.top <= 0.09 * ph and ln.size <= body_size * 1.15:
                if nt in chrome_top or ln.size <= body_size * 0.9:
                    i += 1
                    continue

            if not t:
                i += 1
                continue

            if is_code_line(ln):
                flush_blank()
                buf = []
                while i < n and is_code_line(lines[i]):
                    buf.append(lines[i].text.rstrip())
                    i += 1
                out.append("```svrf")
                out.extend(buf)
                out.append("```")
                out.append("")
                first = True
                prev_bottom = -1
                continue

            # heading detection (bold and/or large text)
            is_heading = (ln.bold and ln.size >= body_size * 0.9) or (ln.size >= body_size * 1.3)
            if is_heading and ln.family == "Times" and ln.color != LINK_COLOR:
                nt_title = norm_title(t)
                if not nt_title:
                    # bare chapter number fragment -> drop if a chapter starts here
                    if page_titles:
                        i += 1
                        continue
                elif any(nt_title == e or (e and (nt_title in e or e in nt_title))
                         for e in emitted):
                    i += 1
                    continue
                else:
                    # heading not present in outline -> infer level from size
                    if ln.size >= body_size * 1.6:
                        lvl = 1
                    elif ln.size >= body_size * 1.2:
                        lvl = 2
                    elif ln.bold:
                        lvl = 3
                    else:
                        lvl = 3
                    flush_blank()
                    out.append("#" * lvl + " " + re.sub(r"^\s*Chapter\s+\d+\s*", "", t).strip())
                    out.append("")
                    first = True
                    prev_bottom = -1
                    i += 1
                    continue

            # body paragraph line (soft-wrap in markdown)
            if not first and prev_bottom > 0 and (ln.top - prev_bottom) > ln.height * 1.4:
                flush_blank()
            out.append(t)
            first = False
            prev_bottom = ln.top + ln.height
            i += 1

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""PDF -> Markdown converter emitting one <!-- PAGE n --> marker per PDF page.

Usage:
    python3 pdf2md_conv.py <input.pdf> <output.md> [from_page] [to_page]

Requirements:
    * poppler's `pdftohtml` available on PATH.
    * Python 3 standard library only.

Page markers map 1:1 to the PDF's real pages: page 1 -> `<!-- PAGE 1 -->`,
page 2 -> `<!-- PAGE 2 -->`, and so on, in ascending order.
"""
import sys
import re
import subprocess
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

LINK_COLOR = "#0000ff"


def xml_text(node):
    return "".join(node.itertext())


def get_xml(pdf_path):
    p = subprocess.run(
        ["pdftohtml", "-xml", "-stdout", "-q", pdf_path],
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
    )
    data = p.stdout
    data = data.replace(b"\xfe\xff", b"")
    text = data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    text = re.sub(r"<filename>.*?</filename>", "", text, flags=re.S)
    return text


def parse_outline(root):
    """Return list of (page, level, title) tuples from PDF bookmarks.

    In pdftohtml XML, a nested <outline> that is a SIBLING of <item> nodes
    groups the children of the preceding item.
    """
    out = []

    def walk(node, depth):
        for el in node:
            if el.tag == "item":
                page = int(el.get("page", "0") or 0)
                title = xml_text(el).strip()
                if page and title:
                    out.append((page, depth, title))
                for sub in el:
                    if sub.tag == "outline":
                        walk(sub, depth + 1)
            elif el.tag == "outline":
                walk(el, depth + 1)

    for child in root:
        if child.tag == "outline":
            walk(child, 1)
            break

    seen = set()
    result = []
    for item in out:
        if item not in seen:
            seen.add(item)
            result.append(item)
    return result


class Run:
    __slots__ = ("left", "right", "size", "family", "color", "bold", "text")

    def __init__(self, left, right, size, family, color, bold, text):
        self.left = left
        self.right = right
        self.size = size
        self.family = family
        self.color = color
        self.bold = bold
        self.text = text


class Line:
    __slots__ = ("top", "left", "height", "size", "family", "color", "bold", "text", "runs")

    def __init__(self, top, left, height, size, family, color, bold, text, runs):
        self.top = top
        self.left = left
        self.height = height
        self.size = size
        self.family = family
        self.color = color
        self.bold = bold
        self.text = text
        self.runs = runs


def parse_page(page_el, fonts):
    rows = {}
    row_top = {}
    for t in page_el.findall("./text"):
        top = int(round(float(t.get("top", "0"))))
        left = float(t.get("left", "0"))
        width = float(t.get("width", "0") or "0")
        right = left + width
        height = int(round(float(t.get("height", "0"))))
        fid = t.get("font", "0")
        size, family, color = fonts.get(fid, (0, "Times", "#000000"))
        bold = t.find("b") is not None or t.find(".//b") is not None
        txt = xml_text(t)
        if not txt.strip():
            continue
        bucket = int(top // 3)
        rows.setdefault(bucket, []).append(
            Run(left, right, size, family, color, bold, txt))
        row_top[bucket] = min(row_top.get(bucket, top), top)

    lines = []
    for bucket in sorted(rows.keys(), key=lambda b: row_top[b]):
        runs = rows[bucket]
        runs.sort(key=lambda r: r.left)
        merged = []
        prev = None
        for r in runs:
            if prev is not None and prev.right + 2.0 >= r.left:
                prev.text += r.text
                prev.right = max(prev.right, r.right)
                if prev.size < r.size:
                    prev.size = r.size
                    prev.family = r.family
                    prev.color = r.color
            else:
                prev = Run(r.left, r.right, r.size, r.family, r.color, r.bold, r.text)
                merged.append(prev)
        text = " ".join(m.text for m in merged).strip()
        if not text:
            continue
        size = max(r.size for r in merged)
        all_bold = all(r.bold for r in merged)
        family = merged[0].family
        color = merged[0].color
        for m in merged:
            if m.size == size:
                family = m.family
                color = m.color
                break
        lines.append(Line(row_top[bucket], merged[0].left, height, size, family, color,
                          all_bold, text, merged))
    return lines


def norm_title(s):
    s = re.sub(r"\bChapter\s+\d+\b", "", s, flags=re.I)
    s = re.sub(r"\bAppendix\s+[A-Z]\b", "", s, flags=re.I)
    s = s.strip(" .:\t")
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip().lower()


def is_code_line(line):
    fam = (line.family or "").lower()
    return ("courier" in fam) or ("mono" in fam) or ("console" in fam)


def main():
    args = sys.argv[1:]
    if len(args) < 2:
        print("usage: pdf2md_conv.py <pdf> <out.md> [from] [to]", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(2)
    pdf = args[0]
    outmd = args[1]
    from_page = int(args[2]) if len(args) >= 3 else 1
    to_page = int(args[3]) if len(args) >= 4 else (1 << 30)

    xml = get_xml(pdf)
    root = ET.fromstring(xml)
    outline = parse_outline(root)

    pages = []
    for p in root.findall("./page"):
        pages.append((int(p.get("number", "0")), p))

    fonts = {}
    for fs in root.findall(".//fontspec"):
        fonts[fs.get("id")] = (
            int(float(fs.get("size", "0"))),
            fs.get("family", "Times"),
            fs.get("color", "#000000"),
        )

    parsed = {}
    page_h = {}
    for pnum, p in pages:
        ph = int(float(p.get("height", "0") or "0"))
        page_h[pnum] = ph if ph > 0 else 1188
        parsed[pnum] = parse_page(p, fonts)

    # ---- global body font size (mode of normal body runs) ----
    size_counts = {}
    for pnum, _ in pages:
        for ln in parsed[pnum]:
            for r in ln.runs:
                if r.family == "Times" and r.color != LINK_COLOR and 8 <= r.size <= 40:
                    size_counts[r.size] = size_counts.get(r.size, 0) + 1
    body_size = 16
    if size_counts:
        body_size = max(size_counts, key=size_counts.get)

    # ---- running footer detection (frequency beyond page range) ----
    bot_counts = {}
    total = max(1, len(pages))
    for pnum, _ in pages:
        ph = page_h[pnum]
        for ln in parsed[pnum]:
            t = re.sub(r"[0-9]", "", ln.text).strip()
            if not t:
                continue
            nt = norm_title(t)
            if ln.top >= 0.85 * ph:
                bot_counts[nt] = bot_counts.get(nt, 0) + 1
    threshold = max(20, int(total * 0.6))
    chrome_bot = set(k for k, v in bot_counts.items() if v >= threshold)

    headings_by_page = {}
    for pg, lvl, title in outline:
        headings_by_page.setdefault(pg, []).append((lvl, title))

    out = []
    for pnum, p in pages:
        if pnum < from_page:
            continue
        if pnum > to_page:
            break
        ph = page_h[pnum]
        lines = parsed[pnum]
        page_titles = headings_by_page.get(pnum, [])

        out.append("")
        out.append("<!-- PAGE %d -->" % pnum)
        out.append("")

        emitted = set()
        for lvl, title in page_titles:
            out.append("#" * min(lvl, 6) + " " + title)
            emitted.add(norm_title(title))

        i = 0
        n = len(lines)
        prev_bottom = -1
        first = True

        def flush_blank():
            if out and out[-1] != "":
                out.append("")

        while i < n:
            ln = lines[i]
            t = ln.text.strip()

            # ---- chrome removal ----
            nt_raw = re.sub(r"[0-9]", "", t).strip()
            nt = norm_title(nt_raw) if nt_raw else ""
            if ln.top >= 0.85 * ph:
                if not nt_raw or (nt in chrome_bot):
                    i += 1
                    continue
            if ln.top <= 0.09 * ph and ln.size <= body_size * 0.9:
                i += 1
                continue

            if not t:
                i += 1
                continue

            # ---- code blocks ----
            if is_code_line(ln):
                flush_blank()
                buf = []
                while i < n and is_code_line(lines[i]):
                    buf.append(lines[i].text.rstrip())
                    i += 1
                out.append("```svrf")
                out.extend(buf)
                out.append("```")
                out.append("")
                first = True
                prev_bottom = -1
                continue

            # ---- big headings not present in outline ----
            big_heading = (ln.family == "Times" and ln.color != LINK_COLOR and
                           ln.bold and ln.size >= body_size * 1.3)
            if big_heading:
                nt_title = norm_title(t)
                if not nt_title:
                    # bare chapter-number fragment ("Chapter 2")
                    if page_titles:
                        i += 1
                        continue
                elif any(nt_title == e or (e and (nt_title in e or e in nt_title))
                         for e in emitted):
                    i += 1
                    continue
                else:
                    lvl = 1 if ln.size >= body_size * 1.6 else 2
                    flush_blank()
                    out.append("#" * lvl + " " +
                               re.sub(r"^\s*Chapter\s+\d+\s*", "", t).strip())
                    out.append("")
                    first = True
                    prev_bottom = -1
                    i += 1
                    continue

            # ---- body line ----
            if not first and prev_bottom > 0 and (ln.top - prev_bottom) > ln.height * 1.4:
                flush_blank()
            out.append(t)
            first = False
            prev_bottom = ln.top + ln.height
            i += 1

    md = "\n".join(out).rstrip() + "\n"
    with open(outmd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(md)
    markers = md.count("<!-- PAGE ")
    print("pages=%d markers=%d outline=%d bytes=%d body_size=%d chrome_bot=%d" % (
        len(pages), markers, len(outline), len(md), body_size, len(chrome_bot)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Generic PDF -> Markdown converter.

Emits one `<!-- PAGE n -->` marker per real PDF page (1:1, ascending order).
Preserves bookmarks-based headings, Courier code blocks and simple grid tables.

This script is intentionally generic: it has no hardcoded page counts, titles
or document-specific content, so it can be re-run against any PDF.

Usage:
    python3 pdf2md_conv.py <input.pdf> <output.md> [from_page] [to_page]

Dependencies: poppler's `pdftohtml` on PATH, Python 3 stdlib.
"""
import sys
import re
import subprocess
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

LINK_COLOR = "#0000ff"


def xml_text(node):
    return "".join(node.itertext())


def get_xml(pdf_path):
    p = subprocess.run(
        ["pdftohtml", "-xml", "-stdout", "-q", pdf_path],
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
    )
    data = p.stdout
    data = data.replace(b"\xfe\xff", b"")
    text = data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    text = re.sub(r"<filename>.*?</filename>", "", text, flags=re.S)
    return text


def parse_outline(root):
    """Return list of (page, level, title) from PDF bookmarks."""
    out = []

    def walk(node, depth):
        for el in node:
            if el.tag == "item":
                page = int(el.get("page", "0") or 0)
                title = xml_text(el).strip()
                if page and title:
                    out.append((page, depth, title))
                for sub in el:
                    if sub.tag == "outline":
                        walk(sub, depth + 1)
            elif el.tag == "outline":
                walk(el, depth + 1)

    for child in root:
        if child.tag == "outline":
            walk(child, 1)
            break

    seen = set()
    result = []
    for item in out:
        if item not in seen:
            seen.add(item)
            result.append(item)
    return result


class Run:
    __slots__ = ("left", "right", "size", "family", "color", "bold", "text")

    def __init__(self, left, right, size, family, color, bold, text):
        self.left = left
        self.right = right
        self.size = size
        self.family = family
        self.color = color
        self.bold = bold
        self.text = text


class Line:
    __slots__ = ("top", "left", "height", "size", "family", "color", "bold", "text", "runs")

    def __init__(self, top, left, height, size, family, color, bold, text, runs):
        self.top = top
        self.left = left
        self.height = height
        self.size = size
        self.family = family
        self.color = color
        self.bold = bold
        self.text = text
        self.runs = runs


def cell_join(runs):
    parts = []
    prev = None
    for r in runs:
        if prev is not None and (r.left - prev.right) > 2.0:
            parts.append(" ")
        parts.append(r.text)
        prev = r
    return "".join(parts).strip()


def parse_page(page_el, fonts):
    raw = []
    heights = []
    for t in page_el.findall("./text"):
        top = int(round(float(t.get("top", "0"))))
        left = float(t.get("left", "0"))
        width = float(t.get("width", "0") or "0")
        right = left + width
        height = int(round(float(t.get("height", "0"))))
        fid = t.get("font", "0")
        size, family, color = fonts.get(fid, (0, "Times", "#000000"))
        bold = t.find("b") is not None or t.find(".//b") is not None
        txt = xml_text(t)
        if not txt.strip():
            continue
        raw.append((top, Run(left, right, size, family, color, bold, txt)))
        heights.append(height)

    heights.sort()
    med_h = heights[len(heights) // 2] if heights else 20
    tol = max(4, min(9, int(med_h * 0.4)))

    raw.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
    clusters = []  # [min_top, [runs]]
    for top, r in raw:
        placed = False
        for c in clusters:
            if abs(top - c[0]) <= tol:
                c[1].append(r)
                if top < c[0]:
                    c[0] = top
                placed = True
                break
        if not placed:
            clusters.append([top, [r]])

    lines = []
    for c in clusters:
        runs = c[1]
        runs.sort(key=lambda r: r.left)
        merged = []
        for r in runs:
            if merged and merged[-1].right + 2.0 >= r.left:
                merged[-1].text += r.text
                merged[-1].right = max(merged[-1].right, r.right)
                if merged[-1].size < r.size:
                    merged[-1].size = r.size
                    merged[-1].family = r.family
                    merged[-1].color = r.color
            else:
                merged.append(Run(r.left, r.right, r.size, r.family, r.color, r.bold, r.text))
        text = cell_join(merged)
        if not text:
            continue
        size = max(r.size for r in merged)
        all_bold = all(r.bold for r in merged)
        family = merged[0].family
        color = merged[0].color
        for m in merged:
            if m.size == size:
                family = m.family
                color = m.color
                break
        lines.append(Line(c[0], merged[0].left, med_h, size, family, color, all_bold, text, merged))
    lines.sort(key=lambda l: l.top)
    return lines


def norm_title(s):
    s = re.sub(r"\bChapter\s+\d+\b", "", s, flags=re.I)
    s = re.sub(r"\bAppendix\s+[A-Z]\b", "", s, flags=re.I)
    s = s.strip(" .:\t")
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip().lower()


def is_code_line(line):
    fam = (line.family or "").lower()
    return ("courier" in fam) or ("mono" in fam) or ("console" in fam)


def split_cells(line, gap_thr):
    runs = sorted(line.runs, key=lambda r: r.left)
    cells = []
    cur = []
    for r in runs:
        if cur and (r.family or "").lower() == "symbol":
            cur.append(r)
        elif cur and (r.left - cur[-1].right) >= gap_thr:
            cells.append(cur)
            cur = [r]
        else:
            cur.append(r)
    if cur:
        cells.append(cur)
    out = []
    for c in cells:
        text = cell_join(c)
        if text:
            out.append((c[0].left, text))
    return out


def esc_cell(s):
    return s.replace("|", "\\|").replace("\n", " ").strip()


def main():
    args = sys.argv[1:]
    if len(args) < 2:
        print("usage: pdf2md_conv.py <pdf> <out.md> [from] [to]", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(2)
    pdf = args[0]
    outmd = args[1]
    from_page = int(args[2]) if len(args) >= 3 else 1
    to_page = int(args[3]) if len(args) >= 4 else (1 << 30)

    xml = get_xml(pdf)
    root = ET.fromstring(xml)
    outline = parse_outline(root)

    pages = []
    for p in root.findall("./page"):
        pages.append((int(p.get("number", "0")), p))

    fonts = {}
    for fs in root.findall(".//fontspec"):
        fonts[fs.get("id")] = (
            int(float(fs.get("size", "0"))),
            fs.get("family", "Times"),
            fs.get("color", "#000000"),
        )

    parsed = {}
    page_h = {}
    for pnum, p in pages:
        ph = int(float(p.get("height", "0") or "0"))
        page_h[pnum] = ph if ph > 0 else 1188
        parsed[pnum] = parse_page(p, fonts)

    # global body size (mode of normal Times runs)
    size_counts = {}
    for pnum, _ in pages:
        for ln in parsed[pnum]:
            for r in ln.runs:
                if r.family == "Times" and r.color != LINK_COLOR and 8 <= r.size <= 40:
                    size_counts[r.size] = size_counts.get(r.size, 0) + 1
    body_size = 16
    if size_counts:
        body_size = max(size_counts, key=size_counts.get)
    gap_thr = max(25, int(body_size * 1.5))

    # repeated bottom chrome (footer / page number / boilerplate)
    bot_counts = {}
    total = max(1, len(pages))
    for pnum, _ in pages:
        ph = page_h[pnum]
        for ln in parsed[pnum]:
            t = re.sub(r"[0-9]", "", ln.text).strip()
            if not t:
                continue
            if ln.top >= 0.85 * ph:
                bot_counts[norm_title(t)] = bot_counts.get(norm_title(t), 0) + 1
    threshold = max(20, int(total * 0.6))
    chrome_bot = set(k for k, v in bot_counts.items() if v >= threshold)

    headings_by_page = {}
    for pg, lvl, title in outline:
        headings_by_page.setdefault(pg, []).append((lvl, title))

    out = []

    def flush_blank():
        if out and out[-1] != "":
            out.append("")

    for pnum, p in pages:
        if pnum < from_page:
            continue
        if pnum > to_page:
            break
        ph = page_h[pnum]
        lines = parsed[pnum]
        page_titles = headings_by_page.get(pnum, [])

        out.append("")
        out.append("<!-- PAGE %d -->" % pnum)
        out.append("")

        emitted = set()
        for lvl, title in page_titles:
            out.append("#" * min(lvl, 6) + " " + title)
            emitted.add(norm_title(title))

        # table state machine
        tbl_rows = []
        tbl_ncols = None

        def flush_table():
            nonlocal tbl_rows, tbl_ncols
            if tbl_rows and tbl_ncols and len(tbl_rows) >= 2:
                header = tbl_rows[0]
                flush_blank()
                out.append("| " + " | ".join(esc_cell(c) for c in header) + " |")
                out.append("| " + " | ".join(["---"] * len(header)) + " |")
                for row in tbl_rows[1:]:
                    cells = (row + [""] * len(header))[:len(header)]
                    out.append("| " + " | ".join(esc_cell(c) for c in cells) + " |")
                out.append("")
            elif tbl_rows:
                for row in tbl_rows:
                    out.append("  ".join(row))
            tbl_rows = []
            tbl_ncols = None

        i = 0
        n = len(lines)
        prev_bottom = -1
        first = True

        while i < n:
            ln = lines[i]
            t = ln.text.strip()

            # chrome removal
            nt_raw = re.sub(r"[0-9]", "", t).strip()
            nt = norm_title(nt_raw) if nt_raw else ""
            if ln.top >= 0.85 * ph:
                if not nt_raw or (nt in chrome_bot):
                    i += 1
                    continue
            if ln.top <= 0.09 * ph and ln.size <= body_size * 0.9:
                i += 1
                continue

            if not t:
                i += 1
                continue

            # code block
            if is_code_line(ln):
                flush_table()
                flush_blank()
                buf = []
                while i < n and is_code_line(lines[i]):
                    buf.append(lines[i].text.rstrip())
                    i += 1
                out.append("```svrf")
                out.extend(buf)
                out.append("```")
                out.append("")
                first = True
                prev_bottom = -1
                continue

            # big heading (not present in outline)
            big_heading = (ln.family == "Times" and ln.color != LINK_COLOR and
                           ln.bold and ln.size >= body_size * 1.3)
            if big_heading:
                flush_table()
                nt_title = norm_title(t)
                if not nt_title:
                    if page_titles:
                        i += 1
                        continue
                elif any(nt_title == e or (e and (nt_title in e or e in nt_title))
                         for e in emitted):
                    i += 1
                    continue
                else:
                    lvl = 1 if ln.size >= body_size * 1.6 else 2
                    flush_blank()
                    out.append("#" * lvl + " " +
                               re.sub(r"^\s*Chapter\s+\d+\s*", "", t).strip())
                    out.append("")
                    first = True
                    prev_bottom = -1
                    i += 1
                    continue

            # table detection via column gaps
            cells = split_cells(ln, gap_thr)
            if len(cells) >= 2:
                if tbl_ncols is None or len(cells) == tbl_ncols:
                    if tbl_ncols is None:
                        tbl_ncols = len(cells)
                    tbl_rows.append([c[1] for c in cells])
                    i += 1
                    continue
                else:
                    flush_table()
                    tbl_ncols = len(cells)
                    tbl_rows.append([c[1] for c in cells])
                    i += 1
                    continue
            elif tbl_rows and len(cells) == 1:
                # single-column line: wrapped continuation of last row
                target = 0
                best = 1 << 30
                for idx in range(tbl_ncols):
                    # use first row cell x as column anchor
                    ax = tbl_rows[0] and 0
                    d = abs(cells[0][0] - ax) if False else abs(idx - (tbl_ncols - 1))
                tbl_rows[-1][tbl_ncols - 1] += " " + cells[0][1]
                i += 1
                continue
            else:
                flush_table()

            if not first and prev_bottom > 0 and (ln.top - prev_bottom) > ln.height * 1.4:
                flush_blank()
            out.append(t)
            first = False
            prev_bottom = ln.top + ln.height
            i += 1

        flush_table()

    md = "\n".join(out).rstrip() + "\n"
    with open(outmd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(md)
    markers = md.count("<!-- PAGE ")
    print("pages=%d markers=%d outline=%d bytes=%d body_size=%d chrome_bot=%d" % (
        len(pages), markers, len(outline), len(md), body_size, len(chrome_bot)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Generic PDF -> Markdown converter.

Emits one `<!-- PAGE n -->` marker per real PDF page (1:1, ascending order).
Preserves bookmarks-based headings, Courier/monospace code blocks and simple
grid tables. No hardcoded page counts, titles or document-specific content.

Usage:
    python3 pdf2md_conv.py <input.pdf> <output.md> [from_page] [to_page]

Dependencies: poppler's `pdftohtml` on PATH, Python 3 stdlib only.
"""
import sys
import re
import subprocess
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

LINK_COLOR = "#0000ff"


def xml_text(node):
    return "".join(node.itertext())


def get_xml(pdf_path):
    p = subprocess.run(
        ["pdftohtml", "-xml", "-stdout", "-q", pdf_path],
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
    )
    data = p.stdout
    data = data.replace(b"\xfe\xff", b"")
    text = data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    text = re.sub(r"<filename>.*?</filename>", "", text, flags=re.S)
    return text


def parse_outline(root):
    """Return list of (page, level, title) from PDF bookmarks."""
    out = []

    def walk(node, depth):
        for el in node:
            if el.tag == "item":
                page = int(el.get("page", "0") or 0)
                title = xml_text(el).strip()
                if page and title:
                    out.append((page, depth, title))
                for sub in el:
                    if sub.tag == "outline":
                        walk(sub, depth + 1)
            elif el.tag == "outline":
                walk(el, depth + 1)

    for child in root:
        if child.tag == "outline":
            walk(child, 1)
            break

    seen = set()
    result = []
    for item in out:
        key = (item[0], item[1], item[2].strip().lower())
        if key not in seen:
            seen.add(key)
            result.append(item)
    return result


class Run:
    __slots__ = ("left", "right", "size", "family", "color", "bold", "text")

    def __init__(self, left, right, size, family, color, bold, text):
        self.left = left
        self.right = right
        self.size = size
        self.family = family
        self.color = color
        self.bold = bold
        self.text = text


class Line:
    __slots__ = ("top", "left", "height", "size", "family", "color", "bold", "text", "runs")

    def __init__(self, top, left, height, size, family, color, bold, text, runs):
        self.top = top
        self.left = left
        self.height = height
        self.size = size
        self.family = family
        self.color = color
        self.bold = bold
        self.text = text
        self.runs = runs


def cell_join(runs):
    parts = []
    prev = None
    for r in runs:
        if prev is not None and (r.left - prev.right) > 2.0:
            parts.append(" ")
        parts.append(r.text)
        prev = r
    s = "".join(parts).strip()
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s)


def parse_page(page_el, fonts):
    raw = []
    heights = []
    for t in page_el.findall("./text"):
        top = int(round(float(t.get("top", "0"))))
        left = float(t.get("left", "0"))
        width = float(t.get("width", "0") or "0")
        height = int(round(float(t.get("height", "0"))))
        fid = t.get("font", "0")
        size, family, color = fonts.get(fid, (0, "Times", "#000000"))
        bold = t.find("b") is not None or t.find(".//b") is not None
        txt = xml_text(t)
        if not txt.strip():
            continue
        raw.append((top, Run(left, left + width, size, family, color, bold, txt)))
        heights.append(height)

    heights.sort()
    med_h = heights[len(heights) // 2] if heights else 20
    tol = max(4, min(9, int(med_h * 0.4)))

    raw.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
    clusters = []
    for top, r in raw:
        placed = False
        for c in clusters:
            if abs(top - c[0]) <= tol:
                c[1].append(r)
                if top < c[0]:
                    c[0] = top
                placed = True
                break
        if not placed:
            clusters.append([top, [r]])

    lines = []
    for c in clusters:
        runs = c[1]
        runs.sort(key=lambda r: r.left)
        merged = []
        for r in runs:
            if merged and merged[-1].right + 2.0 >= r.left:
                merged[-1].text += r.text
                merged[-1].right = max(merged[-1].right, r.right)
                if merged[-1].size < r.size:
                    merged[-1].size = r.size
                    merged[-1].family = r.family
                    merged[-1].color = r.color
            else:
                merged.append(Run(r.left, r.right, r.size, r.family, r.color, r.bold, r.text))
        text = cell_join(merged)
        if not text:
            continue
        size = max(r.size for r in merged)
        all_bold = all(r.bold for r in merged)
        family = merged[0].family
        color = merged[0].color
        for m in merged:
            if m.size == size:
                family = m.family
                color = m.color
                break
        lines.append(Line(c[0], merged[0].left, med_h, size, family, color, all_bold, text, merged))
    lines.sort(key=lambda l: l.top)
    return lines


def norm_title(s):
    s = re.sub(r"\bChapter\s+\d+\b", "", s, flags=re.I)
    s = re.sub(r"\bAppendix\s+[A-Z]\b", "", s, flags=re.I)
    s = s.strip(" .:\t")
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip().lower()


def is_code_line(line):
    fam = (line.family or "").lower()
    return ("courier" in fam) or ("mono" in fam) or ("console" in fam)


def split_cells(line, gap_thr):
    runs = sorted(line.runs, key=lambda r: r.left)
    cells = []
    cur = []
    for r in runs:
        if cur and (r.family or "").lower() == "symbol":
            cur.append(r)
        elif cur and (r.left - cur[-1].right) >= gap_thr:
            cells.append(cur)
            cur = [r]
        else:
            cur.append(r)
    if cur:
        cells.append(cur)
    out = []
    for c in cells:
        text = cell_join(c)
        if text:
            out.append((c[0].left, text))
    return out


def esc_cell(s):
    return s.replace("|", "\\|").replace("\n", " ").strip()


def main():
    args = sys.argv[1:]
    if len(args) < 2:
        print("usage: %s <pdf> <out.md> [from] [to]" % sys.argv[0], file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(2)
    pdf = args[0]
    outmd = args[1]
    from_page = int(args[2]) if len(args) >= 3 else 1
    to_page = int(args[3]) if len(args) >= 4 else (1 << 30)

    xml = get_xml(pdf)
    root = ET.fromstring(xml)
    outline = parse_outline(root)

    pages = []
    for p in root.findall("./page"):
        pages.append((int(p.get("number", "0")), p))

    fonts = {}
    for fs in root.findall(".//fontspec"):
        fonts[fs.get("id")] = (
